title: XShell Effective Configuration

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration.

app.description: Effective application view constructed by bootstrap from the selected root module and deployment values; never an authored top-level object.

modules.description: Resolved modules participating in the application.

basePath.description: Application-root-relative Path prefix under which the application is hosted; no trailing slash is required.

baseUrl.description: Fully qualified absolute application base-directory URL; ends with / for normal URL resolution.

sources.description: List of source repositories for the application.

app.description: Runtime projection of the selected root module metadata and bootstrap deployment values.

size.description: Size of the physical file in bytes.

hash.description: Hash of the physical file content.

resource.description: Optional lightweight metadata for a recognized XShell resource.

file.description: File entry in the effective XShell resource inventory.

title.description: Human-readable Page or JSON Schema title.

label.description: Human-readable Component, Command, or Contract label.

tags.description: Ordered machine-readable classification identifiers copied from the resource contract.

resource.description: Small descriptive projection of a recognized resource; the Resolver and Loader still own resource access.

configUrl.description: Fully qualified absolute URL of the normalized XShell configuration document.

assets.description: Virtual namespace and physical addressing for XShell assets.

serviceWorker.description: Merged Service Worker configuration augmented by bootstrap with the mappings requested by this effective application generation; not the worker's complete persisted registry.

hash.description: Generated immutable package-generation hash when published.

builtAt.description: Optional UTC time when the immutable XShell package was originally built by pack; excluded from canonical hashing.

files.description: Normalized virtual resource inventory for the XShell framework.

basePath.description: Normalized application-relative root of the virtual asset namespace. (e.g. /_assets)

path.description: Application-root-relative generation-qualified virtual path for XShell assets.

url.description: Fully qualified absolute physical URL of the directory or package containing XShell assets.

mappings.description: Generated mappings requested by this effective application generation. Bootstrap replaces any authored value after configuration merging.

xshellServiceWorker.description: Effective Service Worker configuration. The object is authored and merged normally; mappings is generated by bootstrap.

src.description: Absolute browser URL of a virtual generation path.

version.description: Version of the XShell framework or module.

exceptions.description: Configuration document URLs retained as mapping metadata.

xshellUi.description: Global defaults inherited by pages and components.

error.description: Component used to render component loading errors.

markdown.description: Component used to render Markdown content.

additionalProperties.description: Resolver entries for a logical resource category.

resolver.description: Resolver tables used to translate logical resources into concrete resources.

src.description: Resource source locator or template. May be an application Path or an absolute URL.

loader.description: Loader used to load the resolved resource.

cache.description: Whether the resolved resource may be cached.

cacheMode.description: Cache identity strategy. Full includes the query; path excludes it.

moduleId.description: Identifier of the module that owns the resource.

modulePath.description: Virtual asset path of the module that owns the resource.

resolverEntry.description: Resolution rule for a concrete resource.

options.description: Service-specific configuration passed as the second argument to the implementation constructor.

description: Schema for the final merged and normalized XShell configuration passed to xshell.init().
